articles.title: Property inheritance: How this one document can prevent family disputes later

articles.title: EPFO mandates PF, pension claim settlement within 20 days — What to do if it's delayed?
articles.summary: EPFO employees will experience faster settlements for provident fund, pension, and insurance claims, with a 20-day processing rule. Delays incur a 12% penal interest. Here's how employees can submit their complaints.

articles.title: EPF interest credit delayed? What it means for your savings
articles.summary: EPFO members have begun receiving the annual interest of 8.25% for FY2025-26 in their provident fund accounts, starting July 15. Interest is credited annually, and updates may take time to display, but any delays do not affect the amount earned.

articles.title: Gifting money to your spouse? Here's when tax applies and who pays it
articles.summary: Transferring money to a low-income spouse to reduce tax liability can backfire, as income may be taxed in your hands under clubbing provisions if invested. Details here.

articles.title: EPF withdrawal tax rules explained: When your corpus is tax-free, when it is taxable and how TDS works
articles.summary: EPF withdrawals are tax-free if an employee completes five years of continuous service. Withdrawals before five years may be taxable, except in certain cases such as ill health or employer closure. TDS rules depend on the withdrawal amount.

articles.title: REITs vs REIT mutual funds vs physical property: A complete guide to capital gains tax, TDS and post-tax returns
articles.summary: The same real estate exposure can result in different post-tax returns. REIT mutual funds and listed REITs offer a shorter holding period for long-term capital gains than direct property, while differences in income taxation and TDS can further impact investor returns.

articles.title: ITR filing deadline nears: Why the 31 July deadline is more important than you think
articles.summary: Missing the ITR due date can have consequences beyond a late filing fee. Delayed filing may lead to interest on unpaid taxes and the loss of key tax benefits, such as carrying forward capital losses. Knowing the applicable deadline can help taxpayers avoid unnecessary costs.

articles.title: No international mutual funds left for fresh SIPs after Baroda BNP Paribas Aqua FoF closure: What investors can do now?

articles.title: Income Tax e-filing login FAQs: Answers to common questions on PAN, Aadhaar, OTP, passwords and more
articles.summary: Taxpayers can log in to the Income Tax e-filing portal through multiple methods, even without their registered mobile number.
